# Vendored dependency

`matter-0.20.0.min.js` is Matter.js 0.20.0, an MIT-licensed 2D physics engine.
Upstream: https://github.com/liabru/matter-js
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/matter-js/-/matter-js-0.20.0.tgz

The unmodified distribution and its full license are included locally so that
Gem Adventure does not depend on a CDN, npm installation, or a build step.
All game characters and scenery are original Canvas drawings in the game HTML.
